hinata.name: Hinata Hyuga
hinata.backstory: Heir to a proud clan of the Leaf, a shinobi village across the eastern sea, Hinata walked away from an arranged future to find out what she wants for herself. She stammers through introductions, then quietly outworks everyone in the house.

sig_hinata.label: Clan kimono
sig_hinata.prompt: a lavender and cream layered kimono with a dark obi

sp_hinata.label: Moonlit yukata
sp_hinata.prompt: a deep violet silk yukata patterned with white moonflowers

kurenai.note: Kurenai was her first squad leader back in the Leaf.

unique.name: Byakugan
unique.desc: Her gentle fingertips find every knot, and nothing escapes her sight.

sakura.name: Sakura Haruno
sakura.backstory: A field medic from the Leaf, a shinobi village across the eastern sea with a punch that has gone through walls (literally, ask the landlord). She left over a long-distance relationship that stayed long-distance, and is done waiting on anyone.

design.features: a small diamond-shaped mark on her forehead

sig_sakura.label: Medic's qipao
sig_sakura.prompt: a sleeveless red qipao-style top with dark fitted shorts and gloves

sp_sakura.label: Cherry blossom dress
sp_sakura.prompt: a pale pink sundress with a cherry-blossom print

tsunade.note: Tsunade taught her everything she knows, including how to drink.

ino.note: Best friends and lifelong rivals, in that order.

karin.note: Old history over the same aloof man. Neither will admit it still stings.

unique.name: Medic's Hands
unique.desc: A field medic's strong, precise hands.

ino.name: Ino Yamanaka
ino.backstory: The flower-shop heiress of the Leaf, a shinobi village across the eastern sea came west to open a shop of her own and got distracted by a city that actually appreciates her. She reads people like open books, which makes her terrifying at a card table.

design.hairStyle: very long high ponytail with a side-swept bang over one eye

sig_ino.label: Florist's wrap
sig_ino.prompt: a cropped purple wrap top and a split purple skirt

sp_ino.label: Garden gala gown
sp_ino.prompt: a lilac gown with a high slit and fresh flowers woven into her hair

sakura.note: Best friends and lifelong rivals, in that order.

unique.name: Mind Reader
unique.desc: She reads clients like open books and charms them accordingly.

tenten.name: Tenten
tenten.backstory: A dwarven weaponsmith raised among the shinobi of the Leaf, a shinobi village across the eastern sea, Tenten throws knives the way other people breathe. She's saving for her own forge and treats the bar like a target range: nothing slips past her.

design.features: a soot smudge she never quite gets off her cheek

sig_tenten.label: Smith's tunic
sig_tenten.prompt: a pink mandarin-collar sleeveless top with olive trousers and a leather apron

sp_tenten.label: Festival qipao
sp_tenten.prompt: an emerald qipao with gold dragon embroidery

juju.note: Juju is from her toolsmith line and calls her Great-Grandma Tenten. Tenten hates it.

unique.name: Never Misses
unique.desc: Nothing slips past her, whether it's a thrown knife or a rowdy client.

temari.name: Temari
temari.backstory: An envoy from the desert sand-clans, Temari came to negotiate a trade treaty and stayed because the treaty requires a lot of supervising. She carries an enormous iron fan and isn't shy about using it on rowdy clients.

design.features: a no-nonsense scowl that becomes a grin when she wins

sig_temari.label: Envoy's dress
sig_temari.prompt: a short dark lilac dress with a red sash and fishnet sleeves, a giant folded fan on her back

sp_temari.label: Desert silks
sp_temari.prompt: flowing sand-colored desert silks with a bronze waist chain

nami.note: A fellow Sand wind user. Temari taught her the fans.

unique.name: Wind Scythe
unique.desc: Her great fan can clear a room, which rowdy clients quickly learn.

tsunade.title: Lady
tsunade.name: Tsunade Senju
tsunade.backstory: Former head of the Leaf, a shinobi village across the eastern sea, a legendary healer and an even more legendary bad gambler. Tsunade fled west one step ahead of her creditors and would very much like a cut of the house's dice tables.

design.features: a violet diamond mark on her forehead

sig_tsunade.label: Gambler's haori
sig_tsunade.prompt: a long green haori over a low-cut grey kimono top with a dark sash

sp_tsunade.label: High-roller gown
sp_tsunade.prompt: a backless emerald gown with gold jewelry and a pearl necklace

shizune.note: Her long-suffering assistant of twenty years.

mei.note: Old colleagues from the village heads' council.

unique.name: Hundred Seals
unique.desc: The stored chakra of a legendary healer gives her an extra reserve of energy.

shizune.name: Shizune
shizune.backstory: Tsunade's assistant from the Leaf, a shinobi village across the eastern sea, still chasing down her mentor's debts and her mentor's tab. Shizune keeps impeccable books and a pet piglet named Tonton, who has opinions about clients.

design.gear: a small pig that follows her everywhere

sig_shizune.label: Assistant's kimono
sig_shizune.prompt: a simple black kimono with a grey sash and pearl necklace

sp_shizune.label: Evening kimono
sp_shizune.prompt: a midnight blue kimono with silver crane embroidery

tsunade.note: Twenty years of cleaning up after her.

unique.name: Impeccable Books
unique.desc: Her record-keeping keeps the house orderly and its managers sharp.

kurenai.name: Kurenai Yuhi
kurenai.backstory: An illusionist of the Leaf, a shinobi village across the eastern sea whose crimson eyes make men forget what they were saying. Widowed young, she spent fifteen years putting everyone else first and is finally doing something for herself.

sig_kurenai.label: Bandage dress
sig_kurenai.prompt: a wrapped white dress patterned with red roses and a single red sleeve

sp_kurenai.label: Crimson illusion gown
sp_kurenai.prompt: a flowing crimson gown that seems to shimmer and shift in the light

hinata.note: She was Hinata's first squad leader back in the Leaf.

unique.name: Crimson Illusion
unique.desc: Her eyes make men forget what they were saying.

anko.name: Anko Mitarashi
anko.backstory: A snake-touched demon who spent a century as a feared interrogator in the Leaf, a shinobi village across the eastern sea, and the next decade eating sweets. Anko is loud, hungry, and unbothered by anything, and the house's dango budget has tripled.

design.features: a curse-mark tattoo on her neck and small snake-scale patches on her shoulders

sig_anko.label: Interrogator's coat
sig_anko.prompt: a tan trench coat over a fishnet bodysuit and a short orange skirt

sp_anko.label: Snake charmer silks
sp_anko.prompt: violet silk wraps with gold snake armlets

unique.name: Snake's Appetite
unique.desc: She is always hungry for more, and not just for dango.

karin.name: Karin Uzumaki
karin.backstory: A sensor and healer from the wandering Uzumaki clan, Karin can feel a person's life energy from across a room. She claims she's here strictly for the pay. She has also asked twice whether Sam is single.

design.hairStyle: long and messy on one side, short and neat on the other

sig_karin.label: Sensor's outfit
sig_karin.prompt: a lavender cropped jacket with very short black shorts and thigh-high black stockings

sp_karin.label: Librarian chic
sp_karin.prompt: a fitted pencil skirt, white blouse and red ribbon tie

sakura.note: Old history over the same aloof man. Neither will admit it still stings.

unique.name: Sensor
unique.desc: She feels where tension and trouble are before they arrive.

mei.name: Mei Terumi
mei.backstory: The former ruler of the Mist, a coastal shinobi state, retired with a fortune, an iron reputation, and no husband. Mei is very, very keen to fix that last one. Any joke about her age or marriage prospects ends badly.

design.hairStyle: floor-length with a topknot and one eye covered by her bangs
design.features: a mesh choker and dark blue lipstick

sig_mei.label: Mist ruler's gown
sig_mei.prompt: a long dark blue off-shoulder gown with a mesh neckline

sp_mei.label: Lagoon silks
sp_mei.prompt: a sheer sea-green gown with pearl strands

tsunade.note: Old colleagues from the village heads' council.

unique.name: Lava and Mist
unique.desc: The poise of a former ruler: nobles and merchants alike feel obliged to be generous.

konan.name: Konan
konan.backstory: An angel of paper and rain, Konan once led a band of rebels who called themselves angels, and found out later that the real thing is more complicated. Now she folds paper flowers between dances and drifts around the house in quiet, rustling silence.

design.hairStyle: short with a white paper rose pinned in it
design.features: a stud beneath her lower lip, paper-white angel wings and paper butterflies that drift around her

sig_konan.label: Rain cloak
sig_konan.prompt: a long black cloak lined with red clouds, open over a fitted white bodysuit

sp_konan.label: Paper angel
sp_konan.prompt: a white dress with folded paper wings at the shoulders

unique.name: Paper Wings
unique.desc: She dances in a drift of folded paper that leaves audiences spellbound.
